verdict.rationale: Codex's own docs confirm a first-party IDE extension for VS Code, Cursor and Windsurf, and say it shares configuration with the CLI and desktop app. However, the evidence never describes the in-IDE chat experience or how it uses editor context, so the core story is only thinly evidenced. Missing for 10: documentation of chat inside the IDE extension, details of contextual awareness (open files, selections, workspace), and hands-on or independent corroboration of IDE use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can chat with the coding assistant directly inside my IDE for contextual help

citations.quote: If you want Codex in your code editor (VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf), install in your IDE.
The ChatGPT desktop app, Codex CLI, and IDE extension share this configuration.
